extracted.name: Vegan Ricotta Cheese
extracted.description: This vegan ricotta cheese tastes just as rich and creamy as the real thing! It's a delicious dairy-free, nut-free, and gluten-free substitute for the ricotta in lasagna, stuffed shells, and more. Find additional uses in the blog post above.
instruction_lines: In a food processor, place the tofu, lemon juice, olive oil, nutritional yeast, lemon zest, garlic, salt, oregano, and red pepper flakes and pulse until creamy.
Use in this vegetarian lasagna recipe or this stuffed shells recipe.
